profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer
profile.summary: iOS engineer with a love for clean architecture, intuitive design, and building experiences that feel effortless to users. I’ve spent the past several years crafting mobile apps that are performant, scalable, and genuinely enjoyable to use. Outside of work, you’ll find me exploring trails with my family, baking something sweet, or getting lost in fiber arts and the elegance of calculus. I believe great engineering is both creative and precise — just like a well-turned stitch or a perfect pie crust.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Cisco I shaped the Webex experience on iOS and across platforms including CarPlay, watchOS, tvOS, and visionOS. One highlight was bringing Webex to CarPlay, which allows people to safely join meetings and check messages from their car.

I also streamlined the release workflow by automating App Store submissions with the AppStoreConnect API, making releases about 60 times faster. Along the way I helped modernize the app by moving features from UIKit to SwiftUI, improved widgets for quick meeting access, and fixed Siri intent handling so voice support works again.

My role combined new feature development, platform expansion, and reliability improvements, all with the goal of making collaboration feel simple and seamless.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I joined the Xbox team to help make sense of massive amounts of gaming data. I built a web scraper in C# and Python that pulled video game metadata into Azure, then used SQL to analyze it and uncover insights for the business. To make the findings useful, I created a dashboard that gave leadership a clear view of trends in the gaming ecosystem.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: This internship was all about experimenting with features to improve the Xbox Assist app. I worked with a small team to design and run A/B tests, digging into customer data to see what resonated and what didn’t. I also partnered with users directly to gather feedback and shape metrics, which helped the team decide which directions to pursue.
